# Olympus OM-D E-M10 (Mark I)

E113 (2014): one mod built for firmware 1.4 and field-tested on one owner body; distinct from the E-M10 Mark II and Mark IV.

**Model code:** E113 · **Also known as:** E-M10, E-M10 Mark I, E-M10 I, EM10 · **Catalogue depth:** initial review

## What you can do with this camera { #features }

Features as each project describes them, with their status. Follow a project's own guide before installing anything.

<div class="feature-grid" markdown="1">

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Film looks** <span class="pill pill-released">Available</span>
{ .feature-head }

18 looks in Picture Mode, the SCP menu, Live View and RAW Data Edit, including Portra 400, Kodachrome 64, Ektar 100 and Gold 200, each with its own icon since 87; Contrast, Sharpness, Highlight, Shadow and Gradation act on them.

[om10mi-mods](../projects/om10mi-mods.md#for-em10) · since v56
{ .card-meta }

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Per-sector colour editor** <span class="pill pill-released">Available</span>
{ .feature-head }

Hue, Saturation and Lightness for 12 named colour sectors, also per bank in RAW Data Edit.

[om10mi-mods](../projects/om10mi-mods.md#for-em10) · since v56
{ .card-meta }

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Per-look colour editor** <span class="pill pill-released">Available</span>
{ .feature-head }

Colour edits for each look on the Custom page (Picture Mode, right key).

[om10mi-mods](../projects/om10mi-mods.md#for-em10) · since v56
{ .card-meta }

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**59:50 video limit** <span class="pill pill-released">Available</span>
{ .feature-head }

Recording limit raised from 29:59 to 59:50; one file is still capped at 4 GB, so high bit rates can stop earlier. Recording past 30 minutes is not yet confirmed.

[om10mi-mods](../projects/om10mi-mods.md#for-em10) · since v56
{ .card-meta }

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Colour wheel** <span class="pill pill-released">Available</span>
{ .feature-head }

PEN-F-style wheel in Color Creator at the ART dial; mark one or more of 12 sectors and set Hue, Saturation and Lightness from -7 to +7 with a live preview that matches the JPEG; kept after power-off. The ART dial no longer reaches the stock art filters.

[om10mi-mods](../projects/om10mi-mods.md#for-em10) · since v87
{ .card-meta }

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**LUT import** <span class="pill pill-planned">Planned</span>
{ .feature-head }

A PC tool fits a LUT, .cube or .xmp file to a look slot as an approximate colour matrix, tone curve and per-sector colour.

[om10mi-mods](../projects/om10mi-mods.md#for-em10)
{ .card-meta }

</div>

</div>
